svg.aria-label: Left: softmax regression on 10 digit classes starts at a log loss of 2.30 with small weights, but far higher with weights that are too large. Right: on 20 examples a healthy training loop drives the loss to nearly zero, while a loop whose labels are misaligned with the inputs stays near 2.3
